entries.title: Projects — group conversations into on-brand folders
bullets: New dedicated page at /loren/projects and the Projects rail item is now live — create named folders (deals, markets, campaigns) with a color swatch, each shown as an on-brand card with its conversations.
An Unfiled bucket collects any conversation not yet in a project, so nothing gets lost.
From Chats, every conversation now has a compact project picker — file a thread into any project in one click; clicking a thread inside a project reopens it.
New owner-scoped loren_projects table with the same RLS pattern as your other Loren tables; conversations link via their existing project_id. Additive — 0 existing product files touched.
entries.bench: loren_projects table + RLS + FK · projects route & rail · per-row filing in Chats

entries.title: Activity board — a live, branded timeline of everything Loren does
bullets: New dedicated page at /loren/activity and an Activity item in the home rail — a Basecamp-style, day-grouped feed of every action Loren has taken.
Each row shows what was asked, the capability that ran (Search · Deal analysis · Results · Conversation) with its own on-brand icon, the time, credits used, and how long it took.
Clicking any item that belongs to a thread reopens that conversation (/loren/c/:id) so you jump straight back in.
Reads the live loren_agent_runs log (owner-scoped), so it's your real history — not a mockup. Full-width, on-brand navy/cyan/violet.
entries.bench: activity route + home rail · loren_agent_runs feed · click-to-reopen · 0 existing files modified

entries.title: Inline property profile — click a listing, page prev/next without leaving the chat
bullets: Results show as your real listing cards in the conversation; clicking one opens the real property page inline (/loren/p/:id) inside the Loren shell.
A slim header gives Back to conversation and Prev / Next to page through the whole result set (with '3 of 24').
The full, filterable /search page is still one tap away via the Full search page toggle.

Why the cards (not the full page) for clicking: your card's PIN badge isn't the database id, so the only reliable way to know which listing you clicked is to render the real card grid where Loren holds the actual listing.
entries.bench: orchestrator v14 · inline profile route · prev/next · full-page toggle · 0 existing files modified
